title: Eval Gate Export Line
description: One JSONL line produced by observability/eval_exporter.py (schema_version eval_export/v1).

timestamp.description: From record end_time, start_time, or timestamp.

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC when the export line was built.

line_index.description: 1-based line in exporter input JSONL (ibridge/intermediate), not eval export output line. Optional traceability only; not used by gate/CI. Smoke fixture (artifacts/eval/smoke_eval_results.jsonl): points to tests/fixtures/eval/ibridge_records.jsonl; manually corrected in fixtures; smoke_ibridge_records row order may differ.

kb_index_status.description: Optional Wave B P3 trace sidecar mirror on source_ref.

trace_metadata_sidecar.description: Optional Wave B P3 observability mirror; does not write gov-trace-v2 JSONL.

kb_index_status.description: Optional Wave B P3 observability sidecar; present only when GOV_EVAL_EXPORT_KB_INDEX_STATUS=1.

kb_index_job_id.description: Optional repo index job id aligned with case index_status (Wave B P3).
